{{Quote|With Parlan gone, I will be fighting Westen. I would like him to know who he is facing...|[[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]]|<ref name="RC" />}}
A '''battle''' was fought at [[Heterkus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Background==
[[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]], hero of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], had recently been recruited by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. For failure to prevent this, [[Ranif Parlan|Parlan]], the previous commander of the [[Relentless (Dorja)|''Relentless'']], had been executed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. [[Westen]] became the new commander and feared a similar fate.<ref name="RC" />

==The battle==
Three ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers appeared over the world of [[Heterkus]] and began bombarding several Rebel strongholds as well as cities that were suspected of rebellion. The Alliance sent help in form of a small fleet under [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] and the cruiser ''[[Silent Water]]''.<ref name="RC" />

As soon as the Rebel Fleet arrived, starfighters were launched by both sides and bombarding with long-range fire started. One of the first Rebel fleet casualties was a small corvette. As the battle progressed, Tallon formed a tactic, based on the fact that he knew the lead Star Destroyer's commander, Westen. With only minimal starfighter cover of one [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], he ordered the [[Unidentified Rebel lieutenant (Silent Water)|pilot]] of the ''Silent Water'' to charge towards the ''Relentless''.<ref name="RC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Heterkus first appeared in the [[West End Games]] sourcebook ''[[The Star Wars Rules Companion]]'' as the introduction paragraph to Capital Ship Combat. The outcome is not specified, however both Tallon and Westen somehow survive the battle, as they appear in later sources.
